question: The ___________ is a meeting of all adults who live in the area covered by a Panchayat.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gram Sabha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gram Sabha** is a **village assembly** consisting of **all the adults** who reside in the area covered by a **Panchayat.**
 
• It is the primary unit of **decision-making** in the **Panchayati Raj system.**
 
• The Gram Sabha meets **at least twice a year** to discuss various issues related to the village, such as** sanitation, health, education, agriculture, and infrastructure.**
 
• The Gram Sabha **elects the members of the Panchayat, **which is the **local self-government body **responsible for the **administration of the village.**
 
• The Gram Sabha also has the power to **approve the annual budget **of the Panchayat, **review its performance**, and** initiate development projects** in the village.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vidhan Sabha** is the **lower house** of the state legislature in India.

 
 
• It is** elected by the people** of the state and has the power to make **laws, approve the state budget, and scrutinize **the work of the government.
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha **is the **lower house** of the **parliament **of India.
 
 
• It is **elected by the people of India** and has the power to make **laws, approve the national budget, and hold** the government accountable.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha** is the **upper house** of the parliament of India.
 
 
• It is **not directly elected by the people** but is composed of members who are **elected by the state legislatures.**
 
• Its role is to represent the **interests of the states **and act as a check on the **power of the Lok Sabha.**
